results.name: Gift Box
results.description:
This 3D model is a beautiful pink gift box, perfect for any occasion. The box is designed with intricate detailing on all sides, adding a touch of elegance to the overall design. The lid of the box is adorned with a large bow, making it the perfect gift for someone special. The box is sized just right for a variety of small to medium-sized gifts, and is sure to add an extra element of surprise and excitement to any gift-giving occasion. Overall, this 3D model is a lovely and versatile addition to any collection.



All my 3D models are free until April 9th!

My TikTok : https://www.tiktok.com/@blender_sketchfab

More info about me on this website : https://sites.google.com/view/info-3d-blender-elias/homepage?authuser=1
